prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star desktop web portfolio comp, first viewport, landscape 16:9
Primary request: Design the first viewport of Costa Maskulov's bilingual creative full-stack developer portfolio in a "Modular Graphic Studio" visual world: a wall of print proofs and production sheets translated into a sophisticated modern web interface.
Structure: unmistakably a website, not a poster. Top navigation with Costa identity, Projets, À propos, FR / EN. An asymmetric twelve-column grid. Left region carries a monumental condensed title and concise positioning. Right region carries one dominant SideQuest project module, explicitly marked as fictitious, with visible metadata and a direct action. A lime primary CTA anchors the grid. Pink editorial notes and production labels are secondary. Show the next section edge below the fold.
Visual system: cream canvas dominant, large violet modules, lime for primary action only, pink for stickers/annotations, near-black text and rules. Strong grid, crop marks, print proof labels, modular cards with purposeful varied scale. Very polished contemporary creative studio, never scrapbook chaos.
Typography: monumental ultra-condensed display for short hero words, precise sans-serif for interface and body, italic organic serif for one accent phrase.
Text (verbatim): "COSTA MASKULOV"; "DÉVELOPPEUR FULL-STACK CRÉATIF"; "DES EXPÉRIENCES WEB SINGULIÈRES"; "VOIR LES PROJETS"; "À PROPOS"; "SIDEQUEST"; "MOCK FICTIF — APPLICATION NON RÉALISÉE"; "PROJET 01"; "FR / EN".
Color palette: #F5F1E8 #4B3CFF #C7FF00 #FF6BD6 #101113.
Constraints: WCAG-minded contrast, clearly keyboard-focusable actions, SideQuest unmistakably a mock, no fake clients/results/repos/awards. One dominant focal composition and calm supporting regions.
Avoid: generic Bento dashboard, generic developer cards, gradients, glassmorphism, neon cyberpunk, brutalist clutter, custom cursor, device mockup, photoreal people, poster-only composition, illegible typography, watermark.
